title: 屋外テラス用のパティオヒーター
description: 飲食店のテラスや屋外待合場所に置くマッシュルーム形の暖房器具。筒形収納部、支柱、ガード付き上部、実際に凹んだ反射傘、操作部と背面点検部を造形。燃料容器の中身・燃焼・熱・発光はなく、火災安全や使用条件を検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.940 × 2.084 × 0.940 m、19,552三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A mushroom-style heater for restaurant patios or outdoor waiting areas, with a cylindrical enclosure, riser, guarded upper assembly, genuinely concave reflector, controls and rear access. No fuel contents, combustion, heat or light emission is supplied; fire safety and operating conditions are not validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.940 × 2.084 × 0.940 m; 19,552 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
